title: The Eelmen
text: Slick grey shapes rise around the boat, one after another, until you are ringed. These are the eelmen of the Marches, with round mouths full of teeth and long cold fingers on the gunwales. They want a toll, and they do not look like they take much else.

options.label: Pay their toll in fish and gold, and keep your fingers inside the boat.

outcomes.text: One by one they sink away, cold fingers sliding off the gunwales. You breathe again.

options.label: Fight them off the boat. No toll for things with mouths like that.

outcomes.text: They pull the fight into the water, where they are strongest. Many more wait below.

options.label: The shrewdest talks them into guiding you through the reeds instead.

outcomes.text: They guide you swiftly through the reeds, grey heads bobbing all around you.
